name: Free Realms
worldbuilding: A collection of kingdoms, republics, city-states, frontier settlements, guilds, and mercenary companies. Their armies rely on conventional soldiers supported by specialists, adventurers, allied peoples, and practical engineering. The Free Realms emphasize cooperation between different battlefield roles rather than unusually powerful individual troops.

factionRule.name: Combined Arms
factionRule.effect: Coordinated Arms: When a friendly Unit makes a Melee Attack against an enemy also Engaged by a DIFFERENT friendly Unit, add +1 Attack die to its combined pool. Alternatively, when a friendly Unit makes a ranged Weapon Attack while wholly within 3" of another friendly Unit, add +1 Attack die to its combined pool; ranged benefit excludes Artillery, Vehicles, War Machines, and Large Assets. Max +1 die from this faction rule per Attack, regardless of supporting Units.
factionRule.knownIssue: Shares its name with the generic Doctrine 'Combined Arms' (rulebooks/chapters/02_wargame/03_non_faction_doctrines.md), which has a different, unrelated 5-Command effect table. Likely intentional thematic echo, not a merge.

factionCommands.name: Coordinated Advance
factionCommands.effect: During the active Unit’s Movement activation, choose up to two friendly Units within Short of it (which may include the active Unit). Each selected Unit may immediately Move up to 2", ending legally. These are additional Moves, not refreshed activations; Disengage and Withdrawn rules still apply.

factionCommands.name: Covering Fire
factionCommands.effect: After a friendly Unit Disengages, choose a different friendly Unit within Short of it that has not yet used its Assault activation. That Unit immediately makes an eligible ranged Attack against the enemy left behind, consuming its normal Assault activation. This does not grant a second Attack.

factionCommands.name: Secure Ground
factionCommands.effect: The active Unit counts as one additional Unit for objective control until the end of the Round.

factionCommands.name: Coordinated Targeting
factionCommands.effect: When the active Unit declares an Attack this Phase, choose Anti-Infantry 4 or Anti-Ranged 4. It gains that keyword for this Attack only, provided the target has the matching tag. Matching Anti ranks do not stack; use the highest. This Command adds its bonus dice once to the combined Unit Attack pool, not per Model.

abilities.name: Disciplined Assault
abilities.effect: When attacking an enemy Engaged by another friendly Unit, this Unit gains Accurate 1.

abilities.name: Mobile Fire
abilities.effect: After resolving a ranged Attack, Move up to 2", without finishing Engaged.

abilities.name: Shield Formation
abilities.effect: When resolving Charge Impact against this Unit, it gains Brace X, where X equals the number of surviving Models in the Unit at the time Impact is resolved. There is no cap on X. Brace reduces the Unit's one incoming Charge Impact pool; it does not prevent the Charge or subsequent melee Attacks.

abilities.name: Experienced Staff
abilities.effect: Commands issued by the Marshal that normally target friendly Units within Short may instead target them within Medium.

abilities.name: Regroup Formation
abilities.effect: Choose one friendly Infantry or Ranged Infantry Unit within Medium. Remove Withdrawn or one temporary Move penalty from it.

upgrades.name: Tactical Withdrawal
upgrades.effect: When an enemy declares a Charge against a friendly Infantry Unit within Medium Range of the Marshal, reposition the targeted Unit up to 2" before resolving the Charge. The Unit must finish in a legal position and maintain Unit coherency. Resolve the Charge against the Unit's new position.

abilities.name: Tactical Spell
abilities.effect: One friendly Unit within Short gains either +2" Move on its next Move or Accurate 1 on its next Attack this Round.

upgrades.name: Runic Detonation
upgrades.effect: Instead of moving this phase, place a 25mm token within Medium Range of this Unit. At the end of the Assault Phase, every Unit with at least half its surviving Models (rounded up) within 1.5" of the token suffers one automatic Magic Hit at Damage 1 total. Resolve Armor then Ward; no Evade. Both sides can be affected. Remove the token after resolving the effect.

abilities.name: Field Refit
abilities.effect: Choose one friendly Vehicle, Artillery, or Ranged Infantry Unit within Short. Either Heal 2 Damage on an eligible mechanical target, or allow one Heavy ranged Attack to be used after movement during its next Attack, worsening Hit by one step.

optionalUpgrades.name: Specialized Guidance
optionalUpgrades.effect: At list construction choose one existing creature/material Trait tag. Other friendly Units wholly within 3" gain Anti-[that tag] 2. Highest applicable Anti rank only. This is a passive aura, not a free Command; does not benefit its source.

abilities.name: Mobile Platform
abilities.effect: May use Repeater Battery after moving, but base Hit is 6+.

abilities.name: Surveyed Battery
abilities.effect: If stationary during the preceding Round, gain Accurate 2 when firing the Grand Cannon.

abilities.name: Veteran Commander
abilities.effect: Friendly generic Infantry and Ranged Infantry Units within Short gain Tough 1 while controlling an objective.

abilities.name: Grand Strategy
abilities.effect: Choose up to three friendly Units within Medium. Each may immediately Move up to 2", and one may remove Withdrawn.

genericUnitsWorthTaking: Shield-and-spear Line Infantry, Longbow Infantry, Light Cavalry, Field Medics, and Scouts. The faction's strength is using ordinary troops together.
designNotes: v4.2 balance pass: added Shielded Fusiliers as the faction's Extra Core (parity with Sacred Orders), reinforcing a defensive precision-firing and anti-Charge role rather than patching a weakness. Damage-1 weapons across the faction gained +1 Attack; Damage-2+ weapons kept their Attacks and gained a thematic Anti-[Type] (Anti-Armored on Greatweapons, Anti-Elite on the Lord-Commander's Command Blade) or an improved Hit (Grand Cannon 4+ -> 3+).
